title: Persephone private rollout - weekly sync scratch
content:
Weekly sync scratchpad - personal prep and post-meeting followups

Context: Persephone Health (pilot customer) on private deployment (VPC + air-gapped on-prem option). Running our semi-managed installer into their staging SAN-backed cluster. Goal this sprint: finish secure key import (HSM), finalize storage mount policy, gate the canary traffic cutover.

Attendees (expected): Lina (me), Marco (installer lead), Priya (SRE), Samir (solutions eng), Jade (Persephone infra lead), + optional: Alex (security reviewer)

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick status (3m) - Lina
- HSM/KMS import status + blockers (5m) - Marco
- Storage/CSI mounts: NFS vs CSI driver decision & perf notes (5m) - Priya
- Network provisioning: firewall rules, Shared VPC peering checklist (5m) - Samir
- Cutover plan for canary (5m) - Lina/Jade
- Action items & owners (4m)

Prep notes (things to mention):
- HSM: customer provided YubiHSM device; we validated keywrap but OEM HSM agent needs 1.3.2 release (security review). If release delayed -> fallback: KMS shim using envelope keys in their KMS (longer audit path). Ask Jade for timeline to provision HSM agent on staging nodes.
- Installer: PR #17 adds --hsm-mode flag; needs e2e smoke with air-gapped artefacts. Marco to run local smoke by EOD Fri.
- Storage: Priya's perf tests show NFS latency spikes on >100 concurrent workers. Recommendation: use CSI-driver (mount propagation + delegated snapshots) for production; NFS acceptable for staging only. Raise cost/ops tradeoffs with Jade (CSI needs storage class rollout).
- Network: Samir found missing 10.8.0.0/24 CIDR in their firewall template; also need to request outbound proxy allowlist for quay.io (for image pulls) — note: air-gapped path will push images via internal registry, but stage cluster currently uses public pulls for convenience.
- Telemetry: confirm whether they want token-level traces; default we ship minimal observability. If they opt-in to deeper telemetry, need to add data transfer limits to contract (comms with legal needed).

Current milestones (short):
- HSM key import validated in DEV cluster - target: 2026-03-10 (done in dev, blocked in staging)
- Installer air-gap smoke (images preloaded, helm templating validated) - target: 2026-03-12 (Marco running)
- CSI storage class approved by customer infra - target: 2026-03-15
- Canary traffic cutover (10% traffic) - target: 2026-03-18

Blockers (top 3):
1) HSM agent release 1.3.2 required for key wrap flow - blocker for staging key import. Owner: Marco. Impact: blocks encrypted key import testing and e2e secure-tokens.
2) Customer infra hasn't approved CSI storage class (security & snapshot policy review). Owner: Jade (customer), Priya (ours). Impact: if not approved, production must use NFS or custom provisioning.
3) Firewall rule for internal registry egress + quay allowlist. Owner: Samir to draft request; Jade to open internal ticket. Impact: delays air-gap image seeding script run.

Action items (from last meeting and this prep) - tentative owners + dates:
- Marco: validate PR #17 with air-gapped artifacts and report smoke results in Slack + attach log tar (target 2026-03-12).
- Marco: if HSM agent not available, prepare KMS shim fallback doc (short runbook) and estimation of extra audit burden (target 2026-03-13).
- Priya: run targeted NFS vs CSI perf bench (30 workers, 100 workers, 200 workers) and paste results into Confluence page; recommend staging vs prod configs (target 2026-03-13).
- Samir: create firewall template diff (include 10.8.0.0/24 and proxy allowlist lines) and send to Jade + CC Lina (target 2026-03-11).
- Lina: add telemetry opt-in clause to the contract notes and ping legal for a short review (target 2026-03-14).
- Jade (Persephone): decide on CSI acceptance or list specific security concerns (target 2026-03-15).

Notes to self (things to ask during meeting):
- "If HSM agent release slips more than 3 business days, do you want us to proceed with KMS shim?"
- "What is the minimum acceptable RPO/RTO for storage snapshots?"
- "Are there network change blackout windows we should avoid for cutover?"

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Schedule separate 1:1 with Jade for CSI deep dive (30–45m) — aim next week if they accept.
- Draft a short one-pager (customer-facing) that explains tradeoffs between CSI and NFS (ops cost + perf) — Lina to draft.
- Check with Legal on telemetry/data transfer addendum; escalate if >3 days.

Meeting minutes template (copy into Confluence after sync):
- Date / time / attendees
- Quick status bullets (what was completed since last sync)
- Decisions made (explicit)
- Blockers & who owns them
- Action items (owner + due date + acceptance criteria)
- Parking lot items / follow-ups

Post-meeting immediate tasks (my checklist):
- Copy action items to Jira (PD-3510 epic) with owners and dates
- Update Confluence page with fresh status and attach Marco's smoke logs
- Slack ping to Marco/Priya/Samir to make sure they're aligned on next steps

Rough timeline notes for PM planning: if HSM release slides to 3/20 -> then production cutover likely 4/01 earliest; need to surface to GTM. If HSM on time and CSI approved -> production cutover 3/26 possible (depends on legal ok for telemetry).

Quick links I will paste in meeting chat:
- Confluence runbook: onboarding/persephone-private-deploy (linked above)
- Installer PR: github.com/redwood-inference/persephone-installer/pull/17
- JIRA epic: PD-3510 (internal rollout epic)

End scratchpad.

-- Lina H.
